name: demo-video-plugin
description: Turns a project repo into a narrated, edited demo video. Reads the codebase, writes a storyboard with real narrative value, prepares deterministic demo state, drives the UI with Playwright (web, launched Electron, or an attached running app) recording one clip per section with Playwright video or OBS over obs-websocket, generates ElevenLabs voiceover, reconciles measured durations into a timeline, and renders the final cut with Remotion or exports it as a Final Cut Pro project.

demo-playwright.description: Drives the app UI and records one video clip per demo section. --caps=devtools is REQUIRED for the browser_start_video / browser_stop_video / browser_video_chapter tools; network/storage/testing enable route blocking, auth injection, and state verification.

demo-elevenlabs.description: Voiceover generation, voice search, and optional music beds via ElevenLabs
